panels.description: Today's America/New_York Neon commitment spend vs daily cap, read from ingest_state (evaluated by llm-ledger commitment-spend feed). Green below $1,125 (75%), yellow $1,125-$1,500, red at or above $1,500 daily cap.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_today_usd' THEN value END) AS REAL), 0.0) AS "Today's Neon Spend",
  COALESCE(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_daily_cap_usd' THEN value END) AS REAL), 1500.0) AS "Daily Cap",
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_today_usd' THEN value END) AS REAL), 0.0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_daily_cap_usd' THEN value END) AS REAL), 1500.0), 0), 1) AS "% of Cap",
  COALESCE(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_today_requests' THEN value END) AS INTEGER), 0) AS "Requests Today",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'neon_today_complete' THEN value END), '1') AS "Complete"
FROM ingest_state

panels.description: Active unique sessions per hour bucketed by time interval, broken down by harness and model family.

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  (h.hour / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000 AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN 'goose / neon'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN 'goose / opus'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'ses_%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN 'opencode / opus'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'ses_%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN 'opencode / neon'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'lgtm-goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN 'goose-lgtm / opus'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'lgtm-goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN 'goose-lgtm / neon'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' THEN 'goose / other'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'ses_%' THEN 'opencode / other'
    WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'lgtm-goose:%' THEN 'goose-lgtm / other'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS series,
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.attr_key) AS Value
FROM hourly h
LEFT JOIN session_program sp ON sp.attr_key = h.attr_key
WHERE h.hour >= $__from AND h.hour < $__to
  AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') IN (${program:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY time

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') AS "Program",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Goose Neon sessions",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Goose Opus sessions",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'ses_%' THEN h.attr_key END) AS "Opencode sessions",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Goose Neon $",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%claude-opus-5-5%' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Goose Opus $",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'ses_%' THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Opencode $",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' AND h.model LIKE '%gemini-4-neon%' THEN h.attr_key END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.attr_key LIKE 'goose:%' THEN h.attr_key END), 0), 1) AS "Neon % of Goose"
FROM hourly h
LEFT JOIN session_program sp ON sp.attr_key = h.attr_key
WHERE h.hour >= $__from AND h.hour < $__to
  AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN instr(sp.tag,'/')>0 THEN substr(sp.tag,1,instr(sp.tag,'/')-1) ELSE sp.tag END,'unresolved') IN (${program:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
